## Warranties, Payments & Policies
- **Replacement Guarantee**: 7-day instant hardware replacement warranty on tested laptops and products (https://www.needelectro.store/return-refund-policy)
- **Service Warranty**: Up to 2 years free service warranty locally in Moulvibazar; manufacturer warranties handled on brand-new hardware (https://www.needelectro.store/warranty-policy)
- **Laptop EMI**: In-house 3, 6, 9, and 12-month installment plans with NID and local guarantor; no credit card mandatory (https://www.needelectro.store/laptop-emi)
- **Shipping & Open-Box Delivery**: Cash on Delivery nationwide with open-box inspection before final payment (https://www.needelectro.store/shipping-policy)
